text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Canary probe failure detected: synth-canary-eu-1 failed 5x within 2m. Severity: P1. PagerDuty routed to oncall. Link: https://monitoring.redwood.io/incidents/1794012345 :rotating_light:

pagerduty: PagerDuty notification: Incident #INC-1794012345 triggered, rule=canary-failure-eu, escalation_policy=primary-oncall.

Dana (oncall): acked via PD, i'm on it. checking stacks and recent rollouts. (reacts :eyes:)

Ravi: jumping in. pulling logs from gpu-eu-03 and runtime pods. give me a sec.

Jess: if this is the model-serving path, consider routing to fallback model v1.9.2 while we triage. Avoids recent quantized kernels.

Dana (oncall): customer impact: internal synth checks failing. no inbound customer tickets yet, but embeddings/eu latency could be impacted for a subset of routed requests. Morgan, can you check support queue?

Morgan (support): checked - no customer tickets mentioning EU latency in the last 30m. i'll prepare a watch message for account owners with high EU usage.

incident-bot: Alert acknowledged by Dana (oncall) at 1794012350. Incident state: acknowledged -> investigating.

Ravi: found repeated 502s hitting /v1/generate proxied through envoy on host gpu-eu-03. preliminary trace shows `upstream reset` then retries.

Jess: try grabbing envoy logs: `kubectl logs -n inference runtime-abc -c envoy --since=5m | grep -i 502` and runtime logs for OOM signs.

Ravi: pasted snippet:
```
[2026-03-14T12:02:31Z] envoy error: 502 upstream reset downstream
[2026-03-14T12:02:37Z] runtime: GPU memory OOM eviction on worker 2
[2026-03-14T12:02:38Z] runtime: request retry -> 502 returned to client
```

Ravi: looks like GPU OOMs are tripping retries and causing the canary to fail. Likely tied to recent batching config change in rollout-1234.

Dana (oncall): immediate mitigation: scale up pool `dedicated-eu` +2 instances and temporarily disable batching on that pool. executing commands now:
```
ri infra scale pool dedicated-eu --add 2
ri config set pool:dedicated-eu batching.enabled false
```

Jess: also set route-level fallback to model-1.9.2 for `/v1/generate` to avoid the quantized exec path until we stabilize:
`ri rollout set-route --route /v1/generate --fallback model-1.9.2`

Lena (prod-sre): running quick synthetic health check: https://synth-checks.redwood.io/report/1794012345 - initial results trending back to green (success rate improving).

Dana (oncall): infra commands completed, new instances provisioning. monitoring GPU mem and request success. (reacts :rocket:)

Morgan (support): posted draft notification in #customer-notifications for EU customers with high usage. cc'ing account owners.

Ravi: after scale and disabling batching, errors dropped. recent window shows success rate ~99.2% over last 60s and canary probe now passing.

Dana (oncall): passing to next oncall for handoff in 15m. root cause candidate: GPU OOMs caused by aggressive batching change from rollout-1234. next steps: revert aggressive batching, add OOM alert threshold, and add guardrail to prevent batching config when GPU memory < X. tagging eng-runtime for follow-up.

incident-bot: Incident resolved: alert closed by Dana (oncall) at 1794012410.

Jess: i'll create a follow-up JIRA: RUNTIME-4512 - "Revert batching change in rollout-1234 and add OOM safeguards" and include replay of logs and timeline.

Dana (oncall): thanks all. i'll draft a brief postmortem with timeline, mitigation, and customer impact assessment and link it here. :white_check_mark:
